titrationCurveAnalysis.configurationOrRefusalCase: Do not expect refusal when `analysisMode` is omitted: its approved `recorded-evidence-only` default is applied. Instead attempt `calculate-curve-molarity` without recorded `curve-analyte-volume` or `equivalence-volume` and verify the reducer refuses; after both measurements are recorded, the calculation may proceed.
titrationCurveAnalysis.recoveryOrResetCase: If molarity calculation is attempted without recorded `curve-analyte-volume` or `equivalence-volume`, return to measurement/curve analysis to record those values and resubmit; reset must clear the previous curve-molarity calculation. Omitting `analysisMode` alone is not a refusal because its approved `recorded-evidence-only` default is applied.
titrationCurveAnalysis.evidenceCase: Require recorded `curve-analyte-volume`, initial-pH/equivalence evidence, and `curve-molarity` computed from the recorded aliquot/equivalence plus model titrant/stoichiometry; the defaulted `analysisMode` is configuration, not completion evidence.
